answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by making reputation decay like a tide that never stops pulling back: every identity must keep earning fresh peer vouches through useful work, and each vouch puts the voucher's own stake at risk, so endorsing a sockpuppet burns the voucher too. A fake farm can light one ember of activity, but it cannot cross the canyon of sustained, costly endorsement that honest agents build over months, and one exposed cluster drains its whole vouching chain at once.
